hero.title: Breathe the data.
hero.subtitle: Atmospheric monitoring across Cartagena. Track PM2.5, CO₂, VOCs and more from multiple sensor nodes.

realtime.title: Always up to date
realtime.desc: Readings from the SEN66 module transmitted at regular intervals. The dashboard always reflects the current state without any page refresh.

versatility.title: Indoors, outdoors & mobile
versatility.desc: Deploy the sensor in enclosed spaces, open air, or moving vehicles. One device, multiple scenarios.

alerts.title: Configurable alerts
alerts.desc: Set thresholds per variable and get notified when air quality exceeds them.
